blocks.tamil_translation: “Shaytan intends to harm one person or two (he tries to cause them loss), but when they become three, he does not intend to harm them,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِثْنَانِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ وَاحِدٍ وَثَلَاثٌ خَيْرٌ مِنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْجَمَاعَةِ فَإِنَّ اللهَ لَنْ يَجْمَعَ أُمَّتِي إِلَّا عَلي هُدًي.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Two are better than one, three are better than two. Four are better than three. So hold fast to remaining with the Jama'ah (together), for Allah Ta'ala will unite my Ummah only upon guidance” (the whole Ummah can never unite upon misguidance; therefore whoever stays with the Jama'ah will be protected from misguidance), Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَرْفَجَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحِ نِ اْلاَشْجَعِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: فَإِنَّ يَدَ اللهِ عَلَي الْجَمَاعَةِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ مَعَ مَنْ فَارَقَ الْجَمَاعَةَ يَرْكُضُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه النسائي، باب قتل من فارق الجماعة...، رقم:٤٠٢٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “The hand of Allah Ta'ala is over the Jama'ah (the special help of Allah Ta'ala is with the Jama'ah). So whoever separates from the Jama'ah, Shaytan joins him and keeps urging him on (to wrong deeds),” Hazrat Arfajah ibn Shuraih al-Ashja'i (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.
